items.title: Hall of Fame Election Rules
items.summary: BBWAA members with 10+ years of coverage may vote. A player becomes eligible five years after retirement, must appear on at least 5% of ballots to stay on the ballot, and is elected with 75% of the vote; the BBWAA ballot window is 10 years. Players who fall short may later be considered by the Era Committees (formerly Veterans Committees).
